summary: @onereach/si-text-message preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: This package advertises itself as a Vue text-message step-input component but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod+x's the binary, and executes the sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly-downloaded runtime via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS module (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with control-flow flattening, a >950-entry string/constant array, and a rotation routine (`WV8StW`) — standard string-array obfuscator shape. The wrapper (`setup.mjs`) itself uses hex-mangled identifiers. The blob is not declared in package.json's `files` field (which lists only `lib/*`), so it is shipped in the tarball outside the declared manifest. There is no legitimate reason for a Vue UI component to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated payload; the runtime swap defeats Node-focused static inspection, and the actual behavior of `math_init.js` runs on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
